basic_details.job_title: KVS Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for TGT, Yoga Teacher and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Purely part-time, contractual panel for session 2026-27

qualification.details: Bachelor Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject. B.Ed. or equivalent qualification from a recognized university. Proficiency to teach in English and Hindi medium. Must have qualified the CTET exam. | The notice asks for yoga and sports teachers or coaches who are qualified and certified in their respective fields (explicitly under PM SHRI). | Candidates must be CTET qualified and hold any one of these qualifications: | XIIth passed and two year D.Ed. Special Education in any of the category of disability. XIIth passed and one year Diploma in Special Education (DSE) in any of the category of disability. Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (DCBR) with 6 months Certification course in Education of Children with Special Needs. Post Graduate Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (PGDCBR) with 6 months certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs. Diploma in Multi Rehabilitation Worker (MRW) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs. Junior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf. Primary level Teacher Training course in Visual Impairment. Diploma in Vocational Rehabilitation - Mental Retardation (DVR-MR) or Diploma in Vocational Training and Employment - Mental Retardation (DVTE-MR) with 6 months Certificate in Education of Children with Special Needs. Diploma in Dearing Language and Speech (DHLS) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs. XII passed with any RCI recognized qualification of minimum one year duration and 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs. Any other equivalent qualification approved by RCI. | See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Original documents relating to eligibility are verified at the walk-in interview
and candidates must be present for this at 8:00 AM. Selection is through the walk-in interview held on the Vidyalaya campus. Candidates are appointed from the panel in order of merit
according to need and requirement. Mere eligibility does not give a right to be called for interview or selection. Candidature may be cancelled if any information is found incorrect on verification.
how_to_apply: Register and apply on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal.
Download the application form from the Vidyalaya website. It is also on pages 3 and 4 of the notification.
Fill in the form and affix one recent passport-size photograph. The form also asks for your age as on 31.03.25, and why you prefer to work in the organisation in 50 words.
Sign the undertaking and attach attested copies of your testimonials, mark sheets and certificates.
Go to the Vidyalaya campus at Ambah Road, Jigni, Morena on the interview date with the documents listed below.
Valid photo ID, such as an Aadhaar card
The note printed on the application form mentions a panel of Vocational Instructor, a post that the interview notice does not list.

content_sections.heading: About PM SHRI K.V. Morena
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Morena is a school at Ambah Road, Jigni, Morena. Contractual appointments from this panel follow the guidelines of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Original documents relating to eligibility are verified at the walk-in interview, and candidates must be present for this at 8:00 AM. Selection is through the walk-in interview held on the Vidyalaya campus. Candidates are appointed from the panel in order of merit, according to need and requirement. Mere eligibility does not give a right to be called for interview or selection. Candidature may be cancelled if any information is found incorrect on verification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: All posts are purely contractual, and appointment is on a part-time, contractual basis in accordance with KVS guidelines. Candidates will have no claim for regular appointment in KVS. Services may be terminated at any time when KVS appoints regular teachers, or without prior information or assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What time should I reach the interview?
faq.answer: Be at the Vidyalaya by 8:00 AM, because attendance at that time is mandatory for document verification. Registration attendance closes at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Is registering on the Samvida Sathi portal compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice requires all candidates to register and apply at samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in, and also to bring the filled application form to the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Is CTET required for the Special Educator post?
faq.answer: Yes. The Special Educator qualifications end with "CTET QUALIFIED", in addition to one of the listed special education qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What marks do I need for TGT?
faq.answer: You need at least 50% marks in the concerned subject in your Bachelor Degree, along with B.Ed. or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Will this job become permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates will have no claim for regular appointment in KVS, and services may end once regular teachers are appointed.

faq.question: Q6. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Which ID proof is accepted?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a valid photo identity card and gives the Aadhaar card as an example.

faq.question: Q8. Does getting on the panel guarantee an appointment?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are appointed as per need and requirement, in order of merit from the panel.
